hero.name: You

dove.name: The dove

boss.name: The trail boss

family.name: The family

leader.name: The riders' leader
leader.look: a hard-faced rider of about forty, black stubble, a dark low-crowned hat, a long grey duster, a gun belt with two revolvers, cracked lips

title: The water road
The water road
story: The caravan moves out at dawn: six wagons, forty barrels of water, and a dry town called Dry Fork on the far side of the desert. You ride at the back with a revolver you've never fired.

choices.say: 2. Take the long trail under the mesa

shot.scene: first light at dawn in the open desert, a low golden sun and dust haze; in the close foreground a mourning dove sits alone on a dead mesquite branch, sharp, filling the top of the frame; far below and behind it, soft and out of focus in the haze, a long wagon train of six canvas-covered wagons loaded with water barrels, each pulled by a team of mules, starts out across the flats; at the very back of the line, small in the distance, a young rider on a bay horse
shot.motion: the dove turns its head and flies off the branch; the camera tilts down past the branch and racks focus onto the wagon train, the mule teams hauling the covered wagons forward through the dust, the young rider at the back

title: The salt flats

story: By noon the salt flats shine like a stove top, and a wagon wheel cracks. The mules won't stand still in the heat.

title: The heat

story: You drink the last of your flask and keep riding. The sky goes white, and then the ground comes up to meet you.
